summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of CoinArchive premium UX-redesigned homepage (iteration 2). All 10 sections render in correct order, all 9 nav testids present and clickable, hero coin image loads (naturalWidth=900, wrapped in div), language toggle EN→DE works ('Submit Coin' → 'Münze einreichen') and persists across reload via localStorage 'ca_lang'. New design elements verified: Manifesto present; FeaturedStory ca-data-list contains Designer/Mintage/Diameter/Weight/Composition rows; all 6 country cards (DE/FR/IT/ES/AT/BE) render monogram letters (no photos) with Germany as feature card (806x649 vs 389x386 for others); 5 mint marks A/D/F/G/J in coin-style circles; stats counters 650+/20+/20+ with meta sublines (SINCE 2004, ACROSS THE EUROZONE, FIRST ISSUE MAR 2004); 6 recent rectangular cards with first two showing 'New' badge, designer attribution lines present; Contribute split layout shows 247 contributors / +12 this week / 651 coins catalogued with avatar stack and View contributors button; Footer has newsletter email input + submit, EN/DE language switcher inside Lang column, decorative mint strip (A D F G J), and 'Curated in Berlin · Made in Europe' line. Mobile 390x844: nav-mobile-toggle present, opens overlay menu, no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=innerWidth=390), hero coin stacks above title. All 9 images have alt text, no broken images, no 404 network requests, no console errors. Timeline year click sets active state (aria-current=true, ca-timeline__year--active class) and updates the featured panel (Plate number + title change).

issues: Spec listed expected year testids timeline-year-2018 and timeline-year-2021, but the actual rendered years are timeline-year-2019 and timeline-year-2022. All 8 year buttons exist and function correctly (click → active marker + panel update), but year values diverge from the review_request spec. Verify with main agent whether the spec or implementation is correct.

Recent-card images still use generic stock photography (gold bars, piggy bank, hands stacking coins, trading-chart imagery) instead of authentic 2-Euro commemorative coin photography. Non-blocking but inconsistent with museum/luxury archive feel.

action_items: Confirm timeline year set: implementation renders 2004/2007/2009/2012/2015/2019/2022/2024 — the review_request expected 2018 and 2021 instead of 2019 and 2022. Decide which is canonical and reconcile.
OPTIONAL (carried from iteration 1): Replace generic stock images in recent-card-* with authentic 2-Euro commemorative coin photographs.
critical_code_review_comments:
data-testid='hero-coin' is applied to a wrapping
, not the . Tests checking element.complete / naturalWidth on this testid will fail because it's not an image element. The child loads correctly (naturalWidth=900). Consider either moving the testid to the or documenting this pattern for testers.

Footer mobile menu overlay opens correctly but uses its own DOM elements (not the nav-coins/nav-countries testids). The nav-* testids in the navbar are hidden on mobile and only the overlay items render. If automated tests need to target mobile menu links, add separate testids (e.g., mobile-nav-coins) or render the same testid in both views.

All other components remain solid: env vars respected, data-testid coverage complete on all interactive/key informational elements, no hardcoded URLs, no console errors, no 404s, all images have alt text.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 15 review checkpoints passed; 1 spec deviation flagged on timeline years)
